text:
Noah (Product): quick follow-up from today's pricing segment — filing sticky questions here about launch capacity and credits handling.

Ivy (Finance): short summary: tokens are consumed normally. We enforce per-minute route quotas and org-level windows. Paid tiers get a short grace burst (standard: 15s; enterprise: 30s). After that you may receive 429s or soft-throttles depending on policy.

Priya (Billing): credits expiry: promo credits 12 months, trial credits 90 days. Enterprise contracts can set custom terms. We also support optional auto-topup for orgs that opt in; requires billing agreement.

Lina (Support): headers on throttle responses: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-Quota-Window`, and `Retry-After`. We're piloting `X-Credit-Balance` for opt-in orgs. Body looks like: `{error: 'rate_limited', retry_after_seconds: 45}`.

omar_k (eng): implementation note: before returning hard 429 we try 1) a short smoothing window, 2) model-variant fallback (quantized), 3) routing to slower ready pools if customer policy allows. These behaviors are configurable per-org.

Noah (Product): for launches — can customers request temporary higher TPS?

Ivy (Finance): yes. Demo/launch passes: standard paid plans get 48-hour auto-approve up to 2x baseline; partners/strategic get 72-hour up to 3x. Anything above that requires Sales approval. Submit via Support with expected peak TPS and token/sec.

Priya (Billing): programmatic checks: `GET /v1/account/credits` (lightly rate-limited) and `GET /v1/usage/summary` for per-route breakdown. Example response body (string): "balance: 15000, expires_at: 2027-09-01T00:00:00Z".

Lina (Support): refund/adjustment policy: if consumption was caused by platform bug or documented misconfig we audit and typically issue credit adjustments in 3-7 business days; include request ids and timestamps in the ticket.

Ava (CEO): strategic note: no pricing changes planned next quarter. We'll publish clearer guidance on model-family pricing and quantization discounts in next month's product update.

Noah (Product): action items I own: 1) publish FAQ with header examples and sample backoff code (exponential + jitter + respect Retry-After), 2) update KB for demo passes, 3) add opt-in instructions for `X-Credit-Balance`. Will post drafts by EOD.

NotifierBot: Slides + transcript uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s/all-hands/2026-05-14/pricing

Ivy (Finance): one last operational note: orgs using Hosted + Dedicated under same billing account: Dedicated is billed via reserved capacity first; hosted credits are used only for fallthrough if cross-fallback is enabled. We'll surface an "effective credit burn" metric in the console soon.

Noah (Product): thanks everyone — tagging @Lina and @omar_k to prepare customer-facing snippets and example client backoff code. :thumbsup:
